boolean_winning_region.fixed_point: W = mu X . (ImmediateP0Win OR (P0Turn AND exists-successor X) OR (P1Turn AND forall-successors X))

terminal_line_factorization.theorem: After W is known, a geometric P0 line L is possible under W/D/L-perfect play from s iff L is reachable by an ordinary existential path entirely inside W from s to a P0 terminal completion of L.
terminal_line_factorization.per_line_fixed_point: P_L = mu Y . (TerminalP0Line_L OR (W AND exists-successor Y))
terminal_line_factorization.simultaneous_form: Q(s) is the union of terminal P0 line labels reachable through W-preserving successors; no universal output quantifier remains after W is fixed.

interpretation: The response-overload predicate O is a derived macro equal to the first universal predecessor A(I); it is not required as a primitive fixed-point seed.
The complete 4x3 winning proof is an alternation-free least-fixed-point reachability calculation from one terminal predicate.
Perfect-play terminal-line classification factorizes into two stages: first solve the Boolean winning region W, then perform existential line-label reachability inside W.

At a P0-turn W state only W-successors are perfect; at a P1-turn W state every legal successor is in W and is equally perfect under W/D/L-only tie semantics. Therefore perfect trajectories from a winning root are exactly paths that remain in W.
This factorization permits the value quotient to remain aggressively minimized while a provenance overlay is used only for the second-stage line-output reachability.
anti_leakage: No standard-7x6 perfect-play terminal-line subset, witness sequence, or solved-state table was used.
